2610.11069.title: Clinician use of language models diverges from how the models are evaluated
2610.11069.paper_summary: Large language model (LLM) assistants are being deployed to clinicians across health systems, and judgments about their readiness rest largely on benchmark scores, most of them derived from examination questions or curated cases. A benchmark predicts performance in deployment only to the extent that its items resemble real use, yet whether benchmarks reflect the work these systems receive has rarely been measured. Here we analyze 127,833 queries sent by 6,342 physicians, advanced practice providers and nurses in 35 specialties to an institutional assistant during an eight-month roll-out. We characterize each query with RCQ-Map, a clinician-validated framework grounded in taxonomies of clinical questions and of LLM evaluation, which records its task, intent, answerability, missing information and potential harm. Documentation and administration (36.2%) and knowledge retrieval (28.9%) made up nearly two-thirds of use, and diagnosis 3.7%; more than a third of queries could not be answered well as posed. Applying RCQ-Map to 58 public benchmarks drawn from major evaluation suites and frontier model reports, which we assemble into the Clinical AI Benchmark Atlas, showed that the median benchmark contained no documentation requests and shared 31% of the task mix of real use, less than an even spread across task categories would. Benchmarks in suites designed to resemble clinical practice were individually no closer to real use than those used in frontier model reports. Benchmark scores therefore say little about how clinical AI performs on most of the work it is actually given, and evaluation should be matched to real clinical use.
2610.11069.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）助手正在健康系統中部署給臨床醫生，對其準備程度的判斷主要依賴基準分數，這些分數大多來自考試問題或精心策劃的案例。基準能預測部署中的表現，僅在於其項目與實際使用的相似程度，但基準是否反映這些系統所接收的工作卻很少被測量。在這裡，我們分析了在八個月的推廣期間，由6,342名醫生、高級實踐提供者和護士在35個專業領域發送的127,833個查詢。我們使用RCQ-Map對每個查詢進行特徵描述，這是一個經臨床醫生驗證的框架，基於臨床問題和LLM評估的分類法，記錄其任務、意圖、可回答性、缺失信息和潛在危害。文檔和管理（36.2%）以及知識檢索（28.9%）幾乎占用了使用的三分之二，而診斷則為3.7%；超過三分之一的查詢無法得到良好的回答。將RCQ-Map應用於58個來自主要評估套件和前沿模型報告的公共基準，我們將其彙編成臨床AI基準地圖，顯示中位數基準不包含任何文檔請求，並且與實際使用的任務組合共享31%，這比在任務類別中均勻分佈的情況要少。在設計上類似臨床實踐的套件中的基準，與前沿模型報告中使用的基準相比，個別上也沒有更接近實際使用。因此，基準分數對臨床AI在實際工作中的表現幾乎沒有任何意義，評估應與實際臨床使用相匹配。
